name: Středověké srdce Evropy
summary: Gothic architecture was born in France and over the course of three centuries swept almost all of Europe, including Bohemia.

name: K poctě zbraň!
summary: What were ancient battles really like? The answer is known to people who have been enchanted by the clank of old weapons, the smell of gunpowder and the weight of medieval armor. We take a look at old battles through the eyes of people who have made it a lifelong hobby.

name: V karavanu po Polsku
summary: Priest and presenter Zbigniew Czendlik, known as Zibi, gets behind the wheel of a caravan and sets off on a journey across a vast country, in whose voivodeships you can find unique monuments, natural attractions, centuries-old traditions and excellent gastronomy. He is interested in the history hidden in the cities, as well as the natural beauty that gives an idea of the diversity of the Polish landscape, which stretches from our borders to the Baltic Sea. These riches, together with the friendliness of the local people, are the reason why Zibi embarks on a journey through his native land with enthusiasm and anticipation.

name: Hot Tub Ranking
summary: Presented by seductive Japanese mistress Mia, this game sees a group of men (hidden behind mirrored glass) ranking a group of women on the basis of various physical attributes. Unable to hear the men, the women must rank themselves in the order that they think the men will put them. For every position they are correct about they win £500 cash.

name: Повелители неба. Крылья победы
summary: A series of documentaries about those without whom the USSR's victory in the Great Patriotic War would have been impossible. Each episode reveals details of the biographies of famous Soviet aircraft designers and scientists. The viewer will learn about the career ups and downs of Pavel Sukhoi, Andrei Tupolev, Nikolai Kamov and many others.

name: With You, Our Love Will Make It Through
summary: When high schooler Mari runs late for school, she never expects to fall for Tsunagu—a gentle, sensitive, beastfolk! In a world where beastfolk are segregated behind walls, Mari and Tsunagu show their differences are truly bridges. Can their love overcome the divide between beastfolk and humanity?

name: Главные роли
summary:
Two young provincial girls, Ira and Zhenya, come to conquer Moscow. If Irina, the eldest of them, has a specific goal of becoming an actress, then Zhenya's plans are not so ambitious. Her passion is cars, motorcycles, engines, and she would be satisfied with any job related to cars.

However, the life of the friends in Moscow is not like a fairy tale - Evgenia cannot find work in any car service, they only need men, and Ira fails to "cleanly" enter the institute, and she is accepted only as an auditor. Chance gives them the opportunity to meet an elderly writer, who also works as a janitor in her own yard. The writer needs extraordinary, life observations, and the two unusual girls find shelter with her for a promise to tell everything about their lives. And life changes dramatically.

name: Блюстители порока
summary: The Russian filmmakers dedicated their thriller to the memory of the outstanding director Alfred Hitchcock. In each episode, the "Master of Horror" will reveal one of his professional secrets. The series uses the plots of the classic's stories. With his inherent desire to understand all the shades of fear, all the degrees of horror, all the flavors of a nightmare. Each film is a complete story with a stunning detective intrigue.

previousepisode.name: Если б не было тебя, ... мама

name: #annaismissing
summary: Anna is a controversial influencer and best known for her provocative online content, but suddenly she goes silent on her social media profiles and mysteriously stops posting any updates. When fifteen-year-old Nina finds a half-naked photo of Anna on her dad's phone, she decides to track down the missing influencer. The shocking events that follow will change not only Nina's life but also her family's. The thriller #annaismissing is a standalone film continuation of the successful series #martyisdead, which was honored with an International Emmy Award in 2020

name: Heart of Stone
summary: Xiao Lang, the newly appointed director, makes a bold entrance—but he's hiding a secret past. Once the rightful heir, he lost everything to his stepmother's scheming. The only light in his dark childhood was Su Mingyu. Now back for revenge, her love becomes his salvation again as love triumphs over vengeance.

name: S:t Görans sjukhus
summary: This gripping documentary series depicts the emotional everyday life at one of the country's largest emergency hospitals, where we also get to follow all the people who work tirelessly day in and day out to save lives.

name: Bodyguardi
summary: Even gangsters can be fun. Each part carries a complete story. The individual stories are told with a disarmingly inaccurate exaggeration, taking the best of what has been created in the genre of crime and gangster films and working with interesting pop culture references.

name: Fight for You
summary: It is said that "All-Service House" accepts any task, whether it's walking dogs, finding cats, or… even stabbing people. Da Hei reluctantly takes on these odd jobs to earn medical funds, unaware that his roommate Xiao Bai is secretly an operative sent by the intelligence agency to take them down. After completing mission after mission, the two rookies' growing dependence on each other deepens each day. But can they be together? Will they choose to reform their ways or continue down the dark path?

previousepisode.name: The future is the days with you by my side

name: Hello, Nice to Meet You. Could You Please Divorce Me?
Большой человек
summary: Matvey, a good-natured IT guy, is hopelessly in love with the dazzling beauty Sveta. A relationship could have developed, but Matthew's extra pounds get up between young people. Sveta sees an overweight guy as just a friend. Matvey understands that his love will remain hopeless if he does not lose a few tens of kilograms. At the gym, Matvey meets a tough coach, Yulia. A difficult life situation forces Yulia to accept Matvey's offer, and become for him not only a coach, but also willpower, a supervisor, and then his best friend.

name: The Mystery of Dragon Town
summary: Corpse herder Xiao Jiu receives a strange late-night order from a mysterious woman to deliver the body of a wealthy young man to an old mansion. Upon arrival, she discovers his parents are preparing a ghost marriage for him. But the next day, they show up at her door claiming the body has vanished, and they demand she return their son's corpse...

name: Agrometal
summary: A comedy TV series set in the wild countryside. To save his marriage, Lukyn decides to take part in an amateur band competition, in which he wins a beautiful motorbike. When he succeeds, he takes his wife out on the motorbike and she will surely forgive him for everything. In short, a perfect plan! What does it matter that Lukyn doesn't have a band and that he can't really play anything...

name: Zoom
summary: On the show, a cast of seven kids known as Zoomers presented various activities such as games, plays, poems, recipes, jokes, movies and science experiments, all suggested by viewer contributions. The cast also had informal chats on subjects such as hospitals, school, family and prejudice, titled Zoomraps. Each episode ended with a choreographed song performed by the cast.

name: The 50
summary: In an unprecedented spectacle we present to you the hottest 50 reality stars in Germany, including Jenny Elvers, Cosimo, Yasin, Cora Schumacher, Georgina Fleur and Matthias Mangiapane - all in one show! In a mysterious castle, ruled by a mischievous lion they fight not for themselves, but for their fans, one of whom will be awarded the prize

name: Poklady Klementina
summary: What exceptional manuscripts are stored in our National Library?

name: Faraday and Company
summary: Dan Dailey stars as private detective Frank Faraday in this 90-minute series, which will share this time period along with "Banacek," "Tenafly'' and "The Snoop Sisters." Dan Dailey returns in a series as a private eye, Frank Faraday. Format calls for Faraday, having served 28 years in a South American jail for a crime he didn't commit, to return to the United States. Not only does he come home to a new era, but a son he didn't know he had (James Naughton). They team up as detectives, with Faraday determined to get the man who killed his old partner.

name: Volcano with Dara O Briain
summary:
For millennia, volcanoes have inspired both awe and fear. In this two-part series comedian and presenter Dara Ó Briain explores the immense power of Italy's most active volcanoes.

There's Stromboli, whose constant eruptions have earned its nickname 'Lighthouse of the Mediterranean'. Mount Etna, where volcanic soils produce some of the best wines in the world. And Vesuvius, where a devastating eruption thousands of years ago buried a city and boiled the brains of its inhabitants.

With stunning visuals, gripping stories, and Dara's trademark wit, this series uncovers the deadly force of volcanoes and their lasting impact on our planet.

name: The Railway Carriage Game
summary: A sparkling celebrity laughter show where the stars, armed with secret phrases, pit their wits against each other.

name: Architektura 58-89
summary: The architecture of the years 1958 to 1989 still arouses passion today. The series, based on the theme of Vladimir 518, takes a comprehensive look at this period, without ideological prejudices.

name: The Cage
summary: When Leanne and Matty discover they are both robbing from the safe at the inner-city casino they work in, their lives are set on a collision course; with each other, the local gangster they're stealing from, and the police

name: Hollywood Demons
summary: Pulls back the glamorous curtain of fame to expose the hidden struggles, sacrifices and scandals of life in the spotlight. From the seemingly cursed dynasties like the Von Erich wrestling family to iconic figures like 7th Heaven's pastor dad Stephen Collins, who are far from their beloved characters, and series plagued by peril and misfortune like Mighty Morphin Power Rangers and The Real Housewives, this new series unveils the shadowy underbelly of Hollywood.

name: Jeremy Pang's Hong Kong Kitchen
summary: Jeremy Pang's Hong Kong Kitchen will follow Jeremy and friends around the great city, delving into the heart of Cantonese culture and its gastronomy. They're not there to simply scratch the surface, but to delve deep and reveal truly authentic emotional human stories and connections with food, plus meet the people who have played a key part in shaping Hong Kong's gastronomical landscape.

name: The Unruly Baker
summary: Join world renowned pastry chef Bernadette (Bets) Gee on a badass baking crash course as she teaches viewers how to perfect their pastry skills; explores staples like macarons, cake pops and more.

name: The Yorkshire Exorcist
summary: Ordained exorcist Ian Lawman is about to embark on his most personal and challenging case yet. This time he isn't cleansing a home or spooky location … he's going to the heart of the issue and tackling a suspected possessed person directly.

name: Planeta Selva
summary: A unique production that travels to Planet Earth's major forests and jungles, providing a complete and unexpected view of their wildlife, biodiversity and importance for all life on our planet.

name: Kian's Bizarre B&B
summary: On a remote island, Kian84 hosts a quirky B&B escape, where BTS' Jin and Ji Ye-eun lead guests through playful exploits and delightful chaos.

name: Carlos Alcaraz: A mi manera
summary: This documentary series follows Carlos Alcaraz as he balances the pressures of a phenomenal tennis career with a 20-year-old's desire to let loose.

name: Policing Paradise
summary: Keep palm and carry on with Bermuda's island-hopping, crime-stopping police force. It's not all blue skies as crews aim to keep locals, tourists and famous faces safe.

name: Une famille en or
summary: Two competing families try to outguess the opponents about survey results.

name: Реванш
summary: The main character is a talented and ambitious Valentina, who dreams of achieving success in science. However, her life turns upside down when she finds herself caught in the center of dangerous intrigues. On the eve of her 23rd birthday, Valentina faces betrayal by people she trusted. A close person fabricates accusations against her, causing her to lose everything: her fiancé, her family home, and the trust of those around her. Valentina embarks on a relentless struggle for justice and love, realizing that the most important thing along the way is not to lose her humanity.

name: My Happy Place
summary: My Happy Place invites viewers on an immersive excursion across the world anchored by an all-star cast of hosts including  Emmy® and Tony® Award winning actor Alan Cumming; Academy Award® nominee and Golden Globe® winning actress Taraji P. Henson; award-winning actor Simu Liu; Grammy®, Emmy® and three-time Tony® Award winning performer Billy Porter; Academy Award® winning actress Octavia Spencer; and Academy Award® winning filmmaker and Grammy® winning musician Questlove. Across six visually stunning episodes, each host reflects on why these meaningful sites have become their escape, revealing a never-before-seen side of the person and the destination.

name: The Dealer
summary: A biting exploration of power, class, seduction and culture set inside the glittering world of the high-end art market, told through the eyes of an aspiring super gallerist and the tangled relationship with her most gifted and unnerving artist.

name: Bibaa & Nicole: Murder in the Park
summary:
Bibaa & Nicole: Murder in the Park, unravelling the story behind the shocking killings of sisters Bibaa Henry and Nicole Smallman, and the police misconduct that followed.  

As the Covid lockdown began to ease in June 2020, a group of friends meet in a London park following Covid guidance to celebrate the birthday of 46-year-old Bibaa Henry. As darkness falls, the friends gradually leave the party, while sisters Bibaa and Nicole stay, dancing in the park. When they fail to return home, they are reported as missing, but their disappearance is not acted upon by the police and the search is left to friends and family. 36 crucial hours later, the bodies of Bibaa and Nicole are tragically found by Nicole's partner. Finally, the police take notice, but in a shocking development, the women's bodies are photographed and shared on social media by the police officers tasked with protecting the crime scene. 

Through moving interviews with the sisters' mother, Mina Smallman and the small group of family and friends at the centre of the search to find them, and insights from the murder detectives investigating the case, the series pieces together the sisters' final hours, the frantic hunt for a serial killer in the making, and the police misconduct that followed. With never-before-seen evidence and police recordings, the series offers a unique insight into the investigation, exposes the attitude behind the behaviour of the police, and examines the failures that left Bibaa and Nicole's loved ones fighting for answers.

name: The Girl Who Caught a Killer
summary:
The Girl Who Caught a Killer follows Rachael Watts, now 42, as she tells her extraordinary story – how, as a seven-year-old girl, she was kidnapped by a stranger, strangled, and left for dead.  

Four years earlier, the "Babes in the Wood" murders of schoolgirls Nicola Fellows and Karen Hadaway had shocked the nation. Despite the evidence, the killer Russell Bishop walked free – free to proclaim his innocence and, sickeningly, lead a hunt for the "real" killer. Rachael not only survived the appalling attack on her, but she was able to pick out her attacker from a police lineup. Bishop was found guilty of her attempted murder, and Rachael's identity remained a secret.  

Now, in this new two-part documentary series, Rachael breaks her thirty-year silence to share her story for the first time on camera, revealing the long-term impact of her trauma, and her role in helping convict a murderer.  Alongside Rachael's story, family members of Nicola Fellows describe their thirty-year struggle for justice, leading to a sensational re-trial. 

Featuring the personal accounts of family, witnesses, police detectives, and with previously unreleased police footage and photos, the series gives unparallelled insight into one of the most notorious crimes in British history, how a second crime exposed the real killer, and how the testimony of one little girl finally caught a killer.

name: Amsterdam Narcos
summary:
The fourth instalment of the critically acclaimed and BAFTA winning Narcos series – Amsterdam Narcos. From the 1970s to the early 2000s, the Dutch city of Amsterdam transformed from a liberal countercultural haven into the drugs capital of Europe. What began as a government tolerating the hash trade soon opened the floodgates to organised crime, leaving the police playing catch up as ecstasy and cocaine smuggling followed. Amsterdam fuelled a pipeline of drugs and criminality through British ports, and right across Europe.  

As the Dutch underworld exploded and with the drugs trade spiralling out of control, law enforcement resorted to desperate measures in a bid to catch the gangsters. Told through the personal testimony of drug users, manufacturers, traffickers, and the detectives who tried to outsmart them, Amsterdam Narcos charts how underground rebellion escalated into an increasingly lethal, multi-billion-pound industry.

name: Абсолютная сотня
summary: Teenager Sonya is a gifted sports shooter. When her brother and father are in danger because of their connections to the criminal world, she is forced to resolve the issue with the help of an old sniper rifle. Now she is suspected by the police and pursued by people thirsty for revenge. Sooner or later, she will have to shoot again...

name: Adictos a la pantalla
summary: Causes and consequences of non-substance addictions consumed by teenagers through their cell phones' screens: social media, porn and online gaming.

name: Wild Workers
summary:
For good or for bad, work is a fundamental aspect of human life.

But it turns out that animals can't escape it, either! In Wild Workers, our protagonists need to work hard to survive: nature has its builders and refuse collectors, its musicians and gardeners and gravediggers, and even its thieves!

So clock in for a full shift with this fresh and fun look at the way the animal world goes to work!

name: Honey
summary:
Honey goes deep undercover in 1980s East Berlin to explore a shadowy world of counter espionage and risky but irresistible relations. 

East Berlin, 1982. Martha, 24, is a deep cover agent for MI6. Surrounded by enemies and constantly under threat of her cover being blown, she tries her hardest to avoid detection by Friedrich Bauman, the new Head of Counter Espionage for the Stasi. Finding herself caught between Friedrich and the reckless, arrogant (and incredibly attractive…) CIA operative Aaron Neeland, she is blind-sided by desire in this Cold War menage-a-trois. The risk of being garrotted or incarcerated is nothing compared to the horrifying ordeal of falling in love. Allowing yourself to be vulnerable and bearing your heart and soul? She'd rather have her fingernails ripped off.

name: Il collegio
summary: Eighteen adolescents between the ages of 14 and 17 have to study for two weeks in a sixties-style boarding school to obtain the diploma of middle school at that time.

previousepisode.name: È ora di spiccare il volo!

name: Ein sehr gutes Quiz (mit hoher Gewinnsumme)
summary: Three people play together on stage. There will only be one winner at the end, so the candidates compete against each other, but they always play the quiz in groups of three. If one person from the group answers correctly, all three players are still in the running. If no one answers, all three people are eliminated and are replaced by the next three in the queue. If one person buzzes and answers incorrectly, they are also eliminated and the next person in the queue takes their place. The other two players remain in the race and the game continues with the next question. There are 90 seconds to buzz after the question has been named. The answer time after the buzzer is five seconds. A total of 25 quiz questions are asked. The player who buzzes the fastest on the 25th question and names the correct answer wins 100,000 euros.

name: Horror Candy
summary: Presents nine eclectic tales of terror, each a unique nightmare ranging from dystopian futures to haunted space stations.

name: Král Šumavy
summary: It is the spring of 1948. Twenty-four-year-old cook Josef Hasil serves in the kitchen of the National Security Corps in Zvonková. Wild boy. He had already experienced the war in a German labor camp and as a link between partisans.

name: Případy mimořádné Marty
summary: Marta is an incredibly intelligent and very individual woman who lacks respect for any authority. He wants nothing to do with the police at any cost. However, when, thanks to her uncontrollable desire to intervene in things and move them forward in an ingenious and innovative way, police chief Klára Hořavová offers her the position of consultant in the homicide department, she finally accepts after a short hesitation. Together with Captain Kreiner and his team, he begins to unravel complicated murder cases with his own personality. Czech adaptation of the 2021 French series HPI.

name: Chlap
summary: The successful doctor Ondřej Frank wakes up in a reality he does not know at all. He must gradually discover and understand the world around him, but especially his own personality.

name: Lubach
summary: LUBACH is een satirisch magazine over het nieuws en actuele thema's. Met scherpe monologen, diepgravende verhalen en ludieke sketches maar ook met verrassende gasten, muziek en stand-up comedy.

name: Jitřní záře
summary: Deals with a clash of values, when a child is taken away from a family because of an inappropriate name. Where does a person's personal freedom end and where does the social norm begin? Is it even possible to live outside the given system today?

name: Dobré ráno, Brno!
summary: The series shows the environment of a live morning show, which it talks about with huge exaggeration. The morning show whose mission is to prepare viewers for the day ahead with a good mood. The show does not have it easy.

name: Chaos
summary:
When Lise, the host of Denmark's morning TV show, meets the charming and adventurous Johannes, who lives a simple life in his van on the Danish coast, she faces the biggest dilemma of her life. Should she risk throwing away her successful career and marriage with co-host Martin in pursuit of adventure and true love? The choice is anything but easy, and Lise's life suddenly feels like great chaos.

Chaos is a romantic and modern love story, which is about achievement and high expectations, not least of yourself, but also about having the courage to realise that happiness is in reality letting go of control and daring love, even when it comes inconveniently.

name: Win Win with People's Postcode Lottery
summary:
ITV1 and ITVX's unique new quiz show Win Win with People's Postcode Lottery will be the most interactive quiz show ever aired in the UK, as viewers playing from the comfort of their sofas get the chance to win the same truly amazing prizes as the contestants playing in studio. 

The series builds to an epic finale where one contestant is guaranteed to win £1,000,000 - and that winner could even be a viewer who made it through to the final.

Created and produced by Hello Dolly and airing on Saturday nights for six weeks, comedy duo Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins will host, with each show packed with humour, drama and life-changing decisions. 

Playing survey questions based on the views of the Great British public, a 40-strong group of studio contestants, and viewers, play to win prizes including dream holidays, luxury cars, and tickets to some of the world's biggest sporting and entertainment events.

name: Travel Queens
summary: Best friends Lex P and Drea Nicole from "Pour Minds" explore Charleston, Key West, Mexico City, and Cartagena, blending Lex's adventurous spirit with Drea's love for relaxation. They celebrate Black culture, uncover diverse experiences, and create balanced itineraries. Each episode is filled with humor, heart, and practical travel tips.

name: Beer Budget Reno
summary: Everyone dreams of a home makeover, but budgets often get in the way. Enter Kristen Coutts, who specializes in life-changing renovations for those told they can't afford them. Armed with clever, cost-saving hacks, she transforms outdated spaces into fresh, functional homes—proving no budget is too small for a stunning upgrade.

name: The Antidote to Love
summary: During the turbulent years of Dawei, the realm remains divided. Prince Ning, Zhao He, leads his army to war and finds himself on the brink of death. Under imperial orders, the Office of Divination offers a rare medicinal slave to cure his poisoning. That slave, Yi Jiu, secretly the Saintess of the Moon Clan, uses herself as bait and becomes deeply entangled in a web of deception. In the end, Zhao He and Yun Yao work together to uncover the truth behind the Moon Clan's massacre. Together, they overcome life-and-death trials, stay true to their original purpose, and protect peace across the land.

name: Billy Joel: And So It Goes
summary: Billy Joel: And So It Goes is an expansive portrait of the life and music of Billy Joel, exploring the love, loss, and personal struggles that fuel his songwriting. With unprecedented access to never-before-seen performances, home movies, and personal photographs, along with extensive, in-depth one-on-one interviews, the documentary intimately explores the life and work of Joel, whose music has endured across generations.

name: Empress Reborn
summary: The disgraced Empress Shen Miao dies unjustly in the cold palace, but unexpectedly returns to her teenage years. She sees the true, deceitful faces of those around her and sets out on a strong path of revenge, changing the tragic fate of the Shen family. During her quest, she meets the seemingly frivolous but secretly cunning and mysterious young Marquis Xie Jing Xing. From suspicion to alliance, they join forces to fight tyranny and restore peace.

name: A Clean Sheet: Gabe Landeskog
summary: Examine the journey taken by NHL star Gabe Landeskog as he tries to return to the game he loves. A lingering right knee issue has sidelined Landeskog since June 26th, 2022.

name: The Pond is Adorned with Blossoming Lotus
Kill List: Hunted by Putin's Spies
summary: In this immersive, gripping documentary, journalist Christo Grozev - famous for exposing Putin's murder machinery - discovers that he's under threat and goes on the run

name: Bog Amach
summary:
Presenter Emer Mhic an Fhailí has a passion for property and interior design. In Bog Amach she takes six couples and families to spectacular locations across the country as they search for the perfect place to settle.

Each week we show our house-hunters three potential properties in their chosen area. As theyview houses, some ready to move into, others in need of a little more work, they get a sense ofjust how far their money can go. The search will throw up some unexpected challenges and some pleasant surprises.

name: Киловаттино
summary: Teacher Olga Golubeva gets hooked by scammers and now owes the bank three million. Her husband Vadim's plan to sell the village house is not working. Then Golubev's son Zhorik offers to create a farm, but not to grow vegetables, but money. After all, a village with cheap electricity is an ideal place for mining. All that remains is to hide this idea from the collectors, the village chairman and the school principal.

name: Prescription: Nutrition
summary: In this exclusive, original CuriosityStream documentary series, doctors, chefs and nutritionists weigh in on how changes in diet can positively affect health and longevity.

name: The Eagle's Return
summary:
This wildlife series follows the trial the trials of three teams bringing wild birds of prey back to Ireland after an absence of over 100 years. It is the most important Irish wildlife story in decades - the return of some of the largest birds of prey ever to darken Irish skies, the White Tailed Eagle, the Golden Eagle and the Red Kite.

From scaling cliffs in the wilds of Norway, Scotland and Wales on the hunt for new chicks, to hiring planes to fly them home, to nursing them through the first crucial months of freedom, the reintroduction involves a vast amount of work for a team of highly trained specialists. It follows their triumphs and tragedies as they track the birds from capture abroad through the first months of their release in Ireland. With radio & satellite tags, the guardians follow the released birds' progress across the country and wait and hope they will survive through their first winter.

World-class wildlife photography, unfolding dramatic storylines, strong human & animal interest, important environmental, cultural and heritage themes - all combine to make this a compelling and important series with appeal for a very wide audience.

name: Maleika's African Tales
summary: I‘m Maleika, the famous Cheetah, and I would like to share with you the stories of my fellow friends in the African continent. Africa is a place of beauty, grace, joy and hidden danger. Of course, it‘s just me who narrates the stories, but my kids are keen to be seen as well :). I believe that you will appreciate how I see the different animals that live close to us, and the good and bad moments that all of us are going through in these tough times.

name: Puffins Impossible
summary: Puffins Impossible follows the adventures of four superhero puffins. With the assistance of their mentor, Johnny Puff, they protect Taigasville from problems caused by the villainous engineer Otto von Walrus.

name: Bad Thoughts
summary: A collection of hilariously disturbing stories that push the boundaries of decency in ways only Tom Segura could imagine.

name: Mystery League
summary: Fifth grade detectives Millie, Mike and Marta attempt to solve the never-ending mysteries of the fictional small Arkansas town of Mulberry Springs.

name: Recalé
summary: Eddy, a math genius and small-time crook, avoids jail-time by going undercover as a teacher. His mission: to identify the kid of a major criminal.

name: True Tilda
summary: Tilda is a young circus girl who saves her friend Arthur from the clutches of the Rev. Glasson. They escape across the West Country, finding new adventures at every turn.

name: Our Golden Times
summary: During the bright days of summer, two people became close friends, but they also parted with a vague emotion. After several autumns and winters, both him and his life have changed drastically. They meet again by chance, and this time, "he" doesn't want to let go again.

name: Тэгри Чину
summary: This series is a fictional, fantasy, action adventure. A fantastic epic journey across the steppe around 800 BC with detailed history that mixes truth and fantasy in a mesmerizing way. Before Ghengis Khan, 33 total tribes of the Steppe united and rose against those that desecrated and mined their land, their descendants who would come to conquer the known world.

name: Ireland's Strongest Woman
summary: The strongest Women from all four corners of Ireland go head to head to be to be crowned the strongest in Ireland!

name: Congonhas: Tragédia Anunciada
summary: The untold stories and human tragedy behind Latin America's deadliest air disaster are investigated in this three-part documentary series.

name: Проверим всё
summary: The new socially acute consumer reality show on CHE! will show how things are behind the scenes of service. Uncompromising hosts, blogger Denis Volevoy and journalist Ekaterina Kashutchik, will study reviews on the Internet and, posing as clients, will conduct a thorough audit of popular establishments. Together, they will create their own quality navigator and tell viewers which doors are best not to enter.

name: Constables on Patrol
summary: Constables patrol the streets of Pennsylvania, deploying undercover schemes to lure people suspected of committing crimes out of hiding and serve them warrants.

name: Pop the Balloon LIVE
summary: Reality stars and everyday singles test their romantic chemistry in this live dating experiment hosted by Yvonne Orji.

name: The 13th Wife: Escaping Polygamy
summary: When Rena and her family arrive in Colonia Le Baron, a secluded polygamist Mormon settlement in Mexico, they are commanded to relinquish all their earthly possessions and devote themselves to the doctrines of the LeBaron brothers, Ervil and Joel. However, as the brothers' insatiable thirst for power ignites growing discord, the community fractures, and Rena's family aligns with Ervil. As his teachings take a harrowing turn towards violence, Rena witnesses the transformation of devoted followers into ruthless killers, indoctrinated to carry out brutal acts. At just 16 years old, Rena becomes Ervil's 13th wife, groomed to serve as one of his so-called 'holy assassins'. After being coerced into committing murder against a rival polygamist, Rena miraculously escapes conviction, yet her fear for her life and her daughter's safety becomes palpable. When Ervil is unexpectedly arrested, Rena seizes the opportunity to escape the oppressive settlement, bringing her daughter and other loved ones with her. Driven by her harrowing experiences, she vows to help others break free from the confines of a life she never wanted.

name: Téacs Taistil
summary:
TG4's Travel series Téacs Taistil is back for its third season. This fun, quirky, and slightly chaotic adventure show has gone from strength to strength—kicking off with an epic first season, levelling up in season two, and now bringing you what we think is the best one yet.

Every week, our three young, totally unique presenters are thrown headfirst into a mystery trip with just one mission: to show us—rain-soaked Irish people—where we should go and what we could do if we hopped on a plane, train, or automobile for a three-day adventure.

With zero time to think, our travellers—Louise Cantillon, Séaghan Ó Súilleabháin, and Proinsias Ó Cuinn—get just 24 hours to pack, wax, and leg it to an unknown destination.

From chasing the Northern Lights in Iceland to roaming the ancient walled city of Split, or even just braving the rickety roads of Cavan, our three highly competitive presenters have to throw themselves into the local way of life—all while waiting for their next set of text instructions.

Where they stay, what they do, and how they eat? That's all decided by a mysterious texter. Over the past two seasons, they've steered boats across straits, shorn sheep on highlands, and even chiselled their own leather sandals—because why not?

But season three takes things up a notch! For the first time, the gang is leaving Europe and getting lost in the sights, sounds, and madness of North Africa. They'll hit the fairgrounds in Seville, take a walk in the clouds over Bratislava, and learn some traditional skills in West Cork.

So what's in store this time? What Insta-worthy moment will Louise capture? What TikTok trend will Séaghan jump on? And will Proinsias finally get over his fear of chickens?

Join the Lad's as they embark on this fun adventure, creating memories to last a lifetime!

name: Red Bull Soapbox Race
summary: Each episode of the wildly entertaining series focuses on a competition in a different city from around the world, including London, Des Moines, Dallas, Edmonton, Johannesburg, Madrid and Sao Paolo. Everyday people will transform into daredevil engineers as they battle to be the fastest to the bottom of the nearly half-mile course. No two events are the same – every track presents distinct challenges, from water features to intimidating "bone rattler" and "final kicker" sections. Teams are judged not only on speed, but also on creativity and showmanship. Winners will take home a trophy along with the ultimate bragging rights.

name: El Mal Invisible
summary: March 2020. Pandemic. In a ghost-like Barcelona due to confinement, a homeless person is murdered while sleeping on the street. It will be the first of a series of crimes committed following the same pattern: always against homeless people, always while they sleep, and always with extreme violence. Agents of the Mossos d'Esquadra police force Quique Molina and Marga Muñoz, at odds with each other over something that happened in the past, will have the mission of finding a serial killer in the midst of a pandemic. A killer who acts like a virus: causing mortality and "infecting" other people who end up following his example. For this reason, the two agents will have to immerse themselves in the underworld of homeless people while Sergeant Molina's own life, in the midst of a divorce, is falling apart.

name: Holiday Touchdown
summary: Alana Higman is sure that her family's lifelong history as Kansas City Chiefs superfans makes them a frontrunner to win the team's "Fan of the Year" contest. Derrick, Director of Fan Engagement, is tasked with evaluating how Alana and her family stack up against the other two finalists. As the pair spends time together, it's clear there's a spark between them but when her grandfather's vintage Chiefs good-luck winter hat goes missing, Alana begins to doubt everything she believed about fate, destiny and even questions her future with Derrick – unless, that is, a little Christmas magic can throw a Hail Mary.

previousepisode.name: Holiday Touchdown: A Bills Love Story

nextepisode.name: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story

name: Loot Kaand
summary: Loot Kaand follows the adventures of the siblings Latika and Palash in the small town of Purulia in West Bengal, where they plan a unique bank heist to save their ancestral house. But unbeknownst to them, dark and sinister forces beyond their control are at play and soon the siblings get trapped in a situation surrounded by vicious gangsters and corrupt policemen.

name: Lo Tomas o Lo Dejas
summary: Lo Tomas o Lo Dejas delivers heart-pounding excitement and suspense as participants navigate high-stakes decisions that could change their lives. With Paul Stanley's infectious energy guiding the action, viewers are in for a thrilling and engaging experience, where luck and a shrewd choice can lead to a $100,000 jackpot.

name: Rose Ayling-Ellis: Old Hands, New Tricks
summary: Rose Ayling-Ellis: Old Hands, New Tricks follows Rose as she sets out to prove it's never too late to learn and embarks on a bold and heartfelt mission to transform the lives of a group of retirees by teaching them BSL. Her goal is to explore whether BSL can enhance their quality of life, deepen connections and combat the isolation that often comes with hearing loss.

name: Home, Land and Sea
summary: Showcasing whānau, hapū and iwi-based enterprises that are putting Māori on the map.

name: AHORA: Planeta Tierra
summary:
Planeta Tierra features in-depth coverage and analysis, investigative reports and on-the-ground reporting from cities across the United States and the Americas. It will include newsmaker interviews and thought-provoking conversations with innovators spearheading creative solutions to address the impact of today's changing climate.

The weekly program will also feature regular contributions from Chief Meteorologist Carlos Robles and special reports from Telemundo local stations.

name: The Future Lover
summary: Zhou Nanfeng travels back in time through a diary, arriving just before Qin Zhiyi's marriage falls apart, hoping to stop Zhong Ziye from seeking revenge on her. As their fates become entangled across timelines, Zhong Ziye relentlessly follows, manipulating events to create misunderstandings and drive a wedge between Zhou Nanfeng and Qin Zhiyi. But when Zhong Ziye unexpectedly dies and Zhou Nanfeng sacrifices himself to protect Qin Zhiyi, she finally uncovers the truth about the time travel. Using the diary once more, she journeys back again – only to realize that everything traces back to Zhong Ziye's love for Song Xingyue. As the four become trapped in an endless cycle of fate, love and hate intertwine, and the truth becomes ever more elusive, shrouded in blood and destiny.

name: Her Trajecting
summary: Shu Yan, a young woman who has always put everyone before herself, has hit rock bottom after losing her family and career. She faces a string of devastating life changes, but as she regains her footing, she begins to rebuild herself and take control of her life. Through this transformative journey, she finds true love with Shen Weizhou.

name: Erbarmungslos
summary: Criminal psychologist Lydia Benecke and profiler Stephan Harbort examine the mental states of historical serial killers, like Jack Unterweger, Guy Georges, Joanna Dennehy, Israel Keyes and others.

name: Admin
summary: Aziz (20 years old) is a second-year IT student who starts to engage in Internet fraud to pay off his mother's debt. When he almost achieves his goal, he is exposed by his own teacher, Timur. In exchange for silence, Timur offers to join his own team of scammers and work on a large scale.

name: Salom Uka
summary: A rich family, accustomed to a comfortable life, loses absolutely everything. They only have their father's house in the village, where they are forced to move and find a common language with a relative and with the local residents.

name: Maktab
summary: A coming of age story about a high-schooler, Sanjar, and his friends.

name: Toshkent 94
summary: The events take place in 1994. Mukha, a well-known person in the criminal world, gets stabbed in the next fight and falls into the river. Internal affairs officers join his gang in order to catch actor Zakir Boho, who is his look-alike.

name: Fara Tashkentskiy
summary: An authoritative Almaty racketeer, after lying in a coma for 23 years, suddenly regains consciousness. To his horror he realizes that it is 2021, his children have grown up, he himself has aged and the world has changed beyond recognition.

name: Hello oyijon
summary: Halima (55 years old) sends her son Shokhrukh (25 years old) to study in America, he returns after studying, and says that he is bringing his daughter-in-law with him. Halima's joy knows no bounds, and she has already gathered all her relatives in the house. But when she sees Shokhrukh's chosen one, the mother is horrified - a dark-skinned girl, Julia, has arrived with her son. Halima does not want to put up with this - after all, this is a disgrace to the entire village. Now Shokhrukh must prove to his mother that there should be no prejudices for true love

name: Meni sev
summary: According to Uzbek traditions, a bride for a son is chosen by his parents. Imagine Anvar's (25) surprise when his first school love agreed to marry him. But immediately after the wedding, Anvar realizes that it was a forced marriage, and Afruza does not love him. Being an honest and decent person by nature, contrary to tradition, Anvar promises his beloved that he will not touch her until she truly loves him. And he begins to seek the love of his wife.

name: Surdik Moskva
summary: Popular comedians from Uzbekistan are heading to conquer Moscow and become popular there, having arrived there they understand that it will not be easy to do

name: Blago nama
summary: The plot of the series follows a family that, in part and forcibly, has to live under the same roof. Ana and Boris are a young married couple with whom, due to a combination of circumstances, her sister and her entire family suddenly move in, as well as her and Ana's father.

name: Chasing Cobbles: Mads Pedersen
summary: The story of Mads Pedersen's steely pursuit of one of the cycling world's greatest triumphs - a victory in one of cycling's five monuments.

name: Anaon
summary: After his wife's death, Max investigates a teen's disappearance. His daughter faces strange events hinting at supernatural forces tied to ancestral myths and her own powers. They must reunite to unravel the mystery.

name: Битва роботов
summary:
This project demonstrates exciting battles of robots controlled by teams of engineers and young specialists from different parts of our country.

The online show shows how Russian robotics is developing and entering the international arena. You will see not only robots, but also real stories of people behind their creation. With each battle, the tension will grow, and in the final, we will find out which team will be the best in this season of the online show.

Each episode will show not only intense battles, but also the behind-the-scenes work of the teams, their victories and failures, technical discoveries and unexpected problems. You will see what tactics the participants choose, how they adapt to their opponents and what decisions they make in critical situations.

name: В активном поиске
summary: Three completely different girls are looking for guys on dating apps. Each has their own preferences and experience of communicating with guys, but the goal is the same - to check whether it is possible to meet your love on the Internet.

name: Нам покер
summary: Three friends decide to open their own small business, but there is a caveat — it is a poker club at home, which means it is illegal. The organizers don't take their idea too seriously, and things are going well at first. But one day the situation becomes more complicated: one of the clients turns out to be an employee of the OBEP. The law enforcement officer says that he is now in a share, otherwise the guys will go to prison, and they have to agree.

name: Концерты
summary:
Listen and watch concerts filmed exclusively for the Votvot platform.

Catching concerts of your favorite artists in emigration is not an easy task, but the Votvot platform will help you with this.

previousepisode.name: Делаем то, что нам нравится – АлоэВера

name: Країна Мрій
summary:
Oleg Skrypka places Ukrainian flags on the musical map of Europe. The leader of the band "Vopli Vidopliassova" travels to European cities where Ukrainian musicians live and create. In each episode, they perform popular songs in a new way.

Where the roots of the song Summertime come from, why "Shchedryk" is famous all over the world and how Ukrainian music exists in the world today - this is only a small part of what you can learn from "Kraina Mriy".

name: Патрон і його друзі
summary:
Everyone knows Patron the dog, but not everyone knows that there are many such little heroes. "Patron and his friends" is a Ukrainian project about dogs (and a little about cats!) who serve for the good of Ukraine.

They risk their lives to support their home country. Some, like Patron, help to de-mine liberated territories. Others - pull people out of the rubble. And there are also emotional support dogs who will lend a paw in difficult times.

name: Одно безумное преступление
summary:
A show about the most brilliant and at the same time absurd crimes.

Evgeny Chebatkov will analyze crime stories in which ideal plans turned into farce, and the criminals themselves became victims of their own stupidity.

name: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System
summary: "You good-for-nothing bastard.. You are the son of a Sword Saint, yet you dare pull such a defective Class!?" During the "Divine Blessing Ceremony" of the 15-year-old Elma who came from a lineage of Sword Saints, he had manifested a commonly deemed defective class known as the Heavy Knight. He had been deprived of his position as the next head of the Edvan Household and was then exiled. The Heavy Knight class had an unbalanced status and useless skills, to top it off, it was even said to be a class cowardly and indolent people have. But, Elma knew better—that this world was the world of the game he had used to play before—and that the Heavy Knight class was the strongest class to exist. Elma made full use of the knowledge he had in his previous life and began his efficient walkthrough of the world he was reincarnated into.

name: Mystery Island
summary: London Police psychiatrist Dr. Emilia Priestly needs to take a relaxing break from her stressful job, so her wealthy friend invites her to Mystery Island, an immersive murder-mystery-themed resort hosting a special retreat for the original investors. As the mystery game begins, tragedy strikes when the resort's reclusive founder is murdered. Emilia "partners" with local detective Jason Trent to investigate.

name: My Status as an Assassin Obviously Exceeds the Hero's
summary: Oda Akira, a high school student who excels in erasing his presence, was summoned along with his classmates to another world. In this world of sword and magic, Akira and his classmates were asked to become heroes and bring down the demon king. Having a bad feeling about the king and the princess who asked them, Akira uses his special skills to sneak into the king's library, in hopes of discovering the truth. Whether to help or abandon his classmates who knew nothing, it all depended on Akira.

name: Montana Jones
summary: The series takes place in the 1930s and is about the adventures of Montana Jones, who goes treasure hunting with his cousin Alfred Jones and the beautiful reporter Melissa Thorn. They visit real locations and cities like the Pyramids of Giza, the Taj Mahal, Istanbul or Easter Island. Frequently they cross paths with Lord Zero - a rich, eccentric art lover and master thief.

name: Ужин с Роговым
summary: A new show in which Alexander Rogov will gather his friends to discuss the news, learn the latest gossip and, of course, play games. At stake is the payment of a joint bill - the most expensive thing in life.

previousepisode.name: #2 | Вечер в Париже. Мягкова, Джабраилов, Мурашкина, Тендерлибае

name: Special Interview
summary: A special interview program that became a TV sensation! A group of autistic interviewers meet celebrities. No question is out of order, and anything can happen.

name: Friends of Grab The Series
summary: On the racetrack we have the finish line as our goal, but not giving up in relationships can be a victory on our own. Meet the miniseries that will make you understand that there is no defeat in this race.

name: Tribe with Bruce Parry
summary: Bruce Parry immerses himself in remote communities deeply connected to the world around them. He finds cultures facing immense challenges, but that are vibrant and full of spirit.

name: Время завтрака
summary: While you are deciding what to eat for breakfast - an omelette or a bun - the stars are already frying, steaming and sharing the secrets of their morning habits. In the studio of the show "Breakfast Time", Anton and Kamilla Dmitriev together with guests cook their favorite dishes, discuss life, habits and most importantly - why salt in porridge. This is not just cooking, but a whole culinary magazine with inspiration for the whole day. Start your morning deliciously - and with a smile.

name: Cub Camp
summary: Follow Judy and Roger Stearns, two regular people with a little bit of land and a lot of heart, as they care for traumatized black bear cubs. See how Black Bear Rescue Manitoba's round-the-clock care gets these little ones ready for the wild life.

name: Tuesday Documentary
summary: Long-running documentary series covering a wide range of current affairs topics.

name: Clean
summary: Lola, a bank cleaner, is going through a divorce and struggling with chronic debt. When she discovers that one of the bank's brokers is engaging in insider trading she realizes that she can solve her money problems by taking advantage of these tips to play on the stock market. But this simple scam soon forces Lola, alongside two of her colleagues, to embrace a dangerous double life.

name: Unbelievable Space Love
summary: Gazing at the scenic view of the sky, a man is joined by a stranger who informs him that he is in a dream. Unable to recall the memories of his life, he relies on the visitor to take him on a journey of discovery. Revealing everything—from their seven-year relationship to the emotional hardships they faced together—the two rekindle their bond severed by time. Behind this beautiful love story, however, lies a much darker truth.

previousepisode.name: MuMu, Sakurako and the Day the Earth Stood Still

name: Space Farmers
summary: GPS, solar cells, Velcro and even baby formula are just some of the inventions space exploration has provided us. Now, Man's mission to go deeper into space has inspired further innovations in producing the food we eat. From the genesis of space food at NASA, to groundbreaking technology in Finland today, which creates protein out of air, scientists have been racing to reshape food production on Earth. Researchers examine how plants react to space conditions in Austria, the Netherlands, Israel and Thailand to grow the next superfood in harsh conditions on Earth. Meanwhile, in Singapore, microalgae grown in bioreactors for space shuttles could be applied in cities, even deserts. Space Farmers will make agriculture on space possible and the growing of food on Earth much more sustainable.

name: The Mononoke Lecture Logs of Chuzenji-sensei: He Just Solves All the Mysteries
summary:
School x Supernatural x Mystery. This story takes place before the exorcist Kyougokudou opened up a used bookstore...

Our setting is in Tokyo in 1948, just right after the war. Kanna Kusakabe had just become a second-year at a high school when she meets the new language teacher, Akihiko Chuuzenji. Mysterious supernatural things keep happening around Kanna. Once again today, Kanna is going to open the doors to the library prep room to seek help from the surly Chuuzenji-sensei who is waiting inside.

A high school supernatural mystery featuring the unlikely duo between a teacher and a high school girl is about to begin!

(Source: Pony Canyon, edited)

name: No Love Zone
summary: Eunkyum has been at his company for a year now. He is friendly, bright, and has a great relationship with his colleagues. But he is unlucky in love—most likely because he is a sucker for looks. That is why he was thrilled when his hot new boss joined the company... before he made Eunkyum's life hell.

name: Intraçables
summary: 7 years ago, Giulia lost her husband David in a tragic accident. One day, a stranger gets into her cab, reviving long forgotten memories. From then on, Giulia and her 17 years old son are forced to flee in an old car and put themselves in a state of "digital death". They will soon find out that the truth lies in David's past.

name: The Tooney and Russo Show
summary: Lionesses Ella Toone and Alessia Russo let Vick Hope in on their friendship, life off the pitch and what it's like inside the England camp.

previousepisode.name: Special Guest Mary Earps Joins the Trio in Ibiza

name: OTT
summary: A late night risqué sketch show featuring most of the TISWAS team, designed to appeal to the large adult audience of the children's Saturday morning show.

name: Sürgünler
summary: As Halil plans to escape to shed light on this conspiracy and to take revenge on those who put him in this situation, he crosses paths with Meryem, the idealist doctor of the prison.

name: The Piano
summary:
To celebrate World Piano Day, the ABC is pleased to announce the highly anticipated new series, The Piano will premiereSunday 4 May at 7.30pm on ABC TV, with all episodes available to watch same day on ABC iview.

Hosted by Amanda Keller, the heartwarming six-part arts series will explore how the piano has the power to transform the lives of everyday Australians, creating refuge, joy and friendship via the touch of a key. 

Invited to perform at unique locations around the country, this series offers Australians the chance to showcase their piano playing talents. These pianists will turn public spaces into hubs of musical brilliance, captivating shoppers, commuters, and passersby as they pause in awe of the performances.

But all is not what it seems. What the pianists don't know, is that they are being observed by two renowned expert musicians, multi-award-winning musical powerhouse Harry Connick, Jr. and one of Australia's greatest classical concert pianists, Andrea Lam.

Hidden away during each performance and watching every note played, they've been tasked with choosing a pianist from each location to mentor. They will then prepare them for a life changing performance at one of Australia's most revered stages, the Sydney City Recital Hall.  

Performing Bach to Beethoven, INXS hits to Taylor Swift's ‘Love Story', these extraordinary pianists from all walks of life will take audiences on an unforgettable piano playing journey.

Set to share their passion for the piano, these everyday Aussies will also share deeply personal stories about their favourite instrument and how it has shaped their lives.

name: Moonshiners: True Crime & Shine
summary: Moonshiners: True Crime & Shine: With insider access only true outlaws can boast, Tim, Tickle, Mark and Digger investigate the crimes at the fringes of America's backwoods tradition.

name: Uniminipet
summary: Dong Woo is a very pleasant, responsible and cheerful boy. He gets weird feelings every time he opens his closet door and is the only one that can sense these feelings. Why is this? Dong Woo is destined to be "the person that opens the Door". His closet is a secret channel that connects the real world to the fourth dimension world called "Uniland ". Whenever he opens the door, the wavelength from the other world is transferred to him.

name: My Mafia Pilot Boyfriend
summary: Flight attendant Tony Baker finds love with pilot Ryan Rossi through Grindr, but their airline romance takes a turn when he learns Ryan's true identity as a mafia heir using his job to smuggle drugs.

name: Steins;Gate: The Sagacious Wisdom of Cognitive Computing
summary:
Steins;Gate: Soumei Eichi no Cognitive Computing is a series of four anime shorts sponsored by IBM and released in both English subtitled and nonsubtitled versions between October 14th and November 12th, 2014. The Steins;Gate series' plot features the IBN 5100, which is inspired by IBM's 5100.

The official collaboration between Steins;Gate and IBM began when the Steins;Gate series creator and president of Mages., Chiyomaru Shikura talked with IBM's Japan branch. These shorts promote IBM's research in cognitive computing, showing how computers could improve life in the future and feature an Upa cognitive computing system.

The shorts were streamed on IBM Japan's website and official YouTube channel.

name: This Is Not a Murder Mystery
summary: Young René Magritte's life is about to change when he's invited to participate in a private art exhibition at an opulent English estate, owned by the flamboyant Lord James. It's 1936 and the art world is abuzz with the rise of surrealism. Fellow guests include Salvador Dali, Lee Miller, Man Ray, and Max Ernst – all artists on the brink of global fame. But after a wild night, Magritte wakes up beside the dead body of a young woman, with no memory of the previous evening. As more bodies fall and Scotland Yard arrives to lock down the estate, Magritte must uncover the truth to clear his name. Is everything what it seems, or nothing at all?

name: For lækker til love
summary: For Lækker til Love (Too Good for Love) is a Danish reality dating show where eight picky singles are looking for love, but they have yet to meet anyone they love as much as themselves

name: Lucky Stars Falling from the Sky
summary: When Hao Rui Chi, a lucky Saturnian, arrives on Earth, he crosses paths with the unfortunate Qi Miao. Together, they begin an unexpected and magical love story.

name: The Man Who Wanted to Change the World
summary:
This series is designed for viewers who know Mauro Rostagno and especially for the many who know nothing about him. Dedicated to all is this passionate journey around the prism of this extraordinary figure, to that existence of his that was capable of transforming itself into many different lives crossing different eras and forms of struggle, with its charisma and its need to change without, however, ceasing to obey the same guiding principle: the constant desire to heal himself and the world.It is a journey that culminates with his murder and the years of research that were necessary to obtain truth and justice, in the labyrinth of incompetence, concealment of evidence, and disinformation.

Rostagno was a ray of light that shone in Italian history for 20 years, from 1968 to 1988, spanning the youth struggles of 1968, his experience at the top of the far-left political group Lotta Continua, the founding of the Milanese social center for political activism and creative expression Macondo, his membership in Osho's ashram in Pune or the creation of his Sicilian ashram, transformed into a rehabilitation center for drug addicts, Saman. He has always been part of something, without allowing that something to swallow him up, label him, steal his invincible originality and uncomfortableness. After Rostagno's murder on September 26, 1988, the investigation was lost in a thousand directions: was it a crime of passion, a family crime, an internal settling of accounts within his own community, a revenge by his former comrades in Lotta Continua, or perhaps the 'elimination of an inconvenient and unwilling witness to dangerous clandestine arms trafficking, in which Freemasonry and Italian secret services were involved? A long painful, exhausting slalom before ascertaining the truth: that it was the Mafia that killed Mauro, which Rostagno was stubbornly investigating, which he was fighting against with his fierce irony and indefatigable intelligence.

name: Success Rate
summary: Bai Wu, a staff member of an antique auction house who has been suppressed and bullied, accidentally triggers a superpower that can calculate the success rate of events. With this ability, he experiences many adventures in the city and continuously grows and rises against adversity.

name: Love Beyond The Curse
summary: Chong Yang of the Yongye Clan has grown weary of his eternal life. In defiance of eternity, he plants the Noctrose to end his life. But the flower never blooms. Not until he meets Ji Nanxing, a girl from the Yan Clan. Cursed to die young, Ji Nanxing's only chance at survival is to marry Chong Yang. One longs for death, the other fights to live. Drawn together by fate, their paths intertwine in an unforgettable tale of love, sacrifice, and redemption.

name: Would You Like a Cup of Coffee?
Holt
summary:
On their way home from a school excursion, Blaize, Umba and Metric, three teenage classmates from the planet Krill who have never previously spoken to each other and are polar opposites in personality, shape and form, are suddenly knocked off course by an electric pulse that's travelling through the universe. They become shipwrecked on the long-forgotten, ancient prison planet of Taos, a threatening world of monsters, magic and secrets, hidden in the universe's Red Zone.

Here, they're greeted by Ginne – a magical, reflective prism. By shaking hands with Umba, Ginne learns that the teens are not a threat but merely lost and good natured so she decides to become their guide. To aid them in their defense against the planet's dark forces, Ginne empowers them with the ability to work together by assembling themselves and combining into one unit – HOLT, a super being who has the wisdom and power of all their planet, parents and ancestors. Holt can fight off most monsters, but he can only sustain his form for a few minutes at a time.

After Blaize, Umba and Metric overhear a strange being's secret message, it becomes clear that the universe is now under attack from an evil, ancient race known as the Ckrook. The teens must now not only survive planet Taos, but also gain allies to fight the Ckrook and help save the universe if they are ever to safely return to Krill, their home.

name: Nol Mewn 5 Munud
summary: Light entertainment for children.

name: Ple Ple Pleiades
summary: Ple Ple Pleiades (ぷれぷれぷれあです) is an anime spin-off of the Overlord series featuring chibi SD characters and taking a more comedic approach.

previousepisode.name: ぷれぷれぷれあです × かげじつ！

name: Другая школа
summary: If you are triggered by the phrase "get out the double sheets of paper", then the show "Another School" is for you. Journalist and blogger Alexander Murashev travels the world and shows the most progressive educational institutions. And he proves that secondary education is not necessarily boredom and cramming. An inclusive school in Estonia, the Danish Epos school with role-playing games, a school without a schedule in Israel - here children learn not only to count and write, but also to accept each other, despite all the differences.

name: Не забудьте выключить телевизор
summary:
Masha Borzunova exposes propaganda fakes now on Votvot!

The former host of the Fake News program on the Dozhd TV channel and one of the most fearless journalists analyzes Russian propaganda every week and takes it apart piece by piece. What they say (or don't say) on television, how the "official" media manipulate us and what exactly they want to instill - we find out, delve into it, and defend ourselves.

name: Гутаркі
summary: "Гутаркі" — the first talk show in Belarusian without censorship. Comedians Idrak Mirzalizade and Mikhas Ilyin talk to viewers and guests about everything under the sun.

name: Великие леди
summary:
An entertaining and educational show about women who changed the world. Hosted by comedian Ariana Lolaeva.

Each episode is a new setting. Ariana literally transforms into the heroines she talks about in order to more clearly show all their difficulties and hardships on the path to greatness. An original approach, easy delivery and signature humor - this is a history lesson that no one will get bored at.

name: Как у них получилось?
summary: A show by journalist Alexander Murashev, in which he does NOT talk about the "beautiful Russia of the future" in theory. Alexander Murashev goes to countries where the most painful problems for Russia could once be found: from landfills the size of cities to corruption and the prison system. And he finds out how they managed to solve these problems. In the first part of the season, together with Alexander Murashev, you will visit Japan, Singapore, Taiwan and South Korea.

name: Музыка, которую нельзя
summary:
A gripping chronicle of censorship in the music industry. Music journalist Lev Gankin takes a tour of different eras and countries, telling how artists of all stripes were banned.

Nina Simone, Prince, Michael Jackson, Turkish opera singer Ruhi Su and Soviet rockers - they all faced repression and were forced to defend their right to free creativity. And sometimes even the right to life.

name: Тайная жизнь верующих
summary:
Podcast by Grisha Prorokov about religions in the USSR. Fascinating stories about how faith broke through the asphalt of repression and persecution.

Representatives of different faiths defended their right to faith with incredible persistence. After all, the USSR actively fought against religion. From this podcast, you will learn how the country went through a thorny path from atheism to the principle of "religion in the service of the state."

name: The Sinful Game of Love
summary: Glamorous Lady Meng Chengcheng begins a collaborative marriage with top celebrity Qin Lang to consolidate her business empire. She lives for power; he will stop at nothing. Both of them are ulterior. Amidst swirling desires, they push each other to the brink while paradoxically becoming each other's salvation. Just as they achieve success, Qin Lang exposes a decades-old vendetta. Vengeance has been his true endgame all along.

name: Чей Цой?
summary:
"Everyone loves the dead - the comfortable and quiet ones," Slava KPSS sings in one of his recent tracks, reasonably noting that the dead will not sell out to the regime, will not make a lousy film, and will not support the annexation of Crimea. Among the exemplary dead in the rapper's martyrology, there is also a place for Viktor Tsoi, the main star of Russian rock, to whom, in fact, no one has any complaints. But there is a regular desire to use his songs and authority to promote anything - from goods to political ideas. But how did it happen that the question "who would Tsoi be with now?" became so important that the most odious deputies, propagandists, and military personnel began to appropriate his work? How did "Kukushka" become the anthem of Z-patriots? Why are Tsoi's heirs seeking support from Putin, and why is the Kino group, having reunited, re-recording old albums?

"Whose Tsoi?" – an eight-episode podcast by the VotVot platform about Kino's songs as a business asset, a tool of manipulation, and an ideological weapon.

name: Документальные фильмы

name: Стендап
summary:
Idrak Mirzalizade, Ariana Lolaeva, Luka Khinikadze, Irina Prikhodko, Ilya Ovechkin, Mikhail Shats. What unites these comedians? They are all not afraid to joke about risky topics.

You can watch the performances of exactly these comedians on the Votvot platform. This is humor that has no boundaries: neither political nor geographical. From complex specials on serious topics to short and light stand-ups - you will surely find something to your taste.

name: Bea's Block
summary: From the makers of Sesame Street, this animated preschool series follows Bea Mantilla, a compassionate and curious Mexican-American five-year-old, as she figures out what it takes to be a good friend. Along with her two best friends, Ty and Lexi, Bea's quest leads them on wacky "Kindness Adventures" around their diverse and inclusive neighborhood of Blocktown. Whether they're creating a "Blocketball" skills camp or searching for a lost chameleon, these three best friends explore a range of emotions from disappointment to excitement, all while learning how to be kind.

name: Bijeli put
summary: After a year and a half of investigation, the police "Department for Special Investigations and Combating Organized Crime" managed to arrest Željko Matić Željco, a former gangster who legalized his business and used it to launder money earned from illegal activities. The arrest was spectacular, but it was overshadowed by the murder of the outgoing chief of the Šibenik-Knin Police Department, Petar Mikulandra, and the discovery of the body of Gabriela Ochoa from Mexico, who had been presumed dead for seven years. The chief's murder casts doubt on the connection between the police and organized crime.

name: Twelve
summary: Inspired by the 12 zodiac animals of the East, Twelve tells the story of 12 angels living in the human world in human form to protect the Korean Peninsula from evil spirits. Long ago, the angels barely managed to seal the forces of evil in the gates of hell through their sacrifice, bringing peace. However, with the evil spirits awakening, chaos returns.

name: Uma Musume: Cinderella Gray
summary:
Uma Musume: Cinderella Gray follows Oguri Cap, a young horse girl whose early promise on the racetrack has been overshadowed by setbacks and the pressures of expectation. Unlike the brighter, more idol-like tone of Pretty Derby, this story takes a more grounded and emotional approach, exploring the struggles, doubts, and determination of its characters.

As Oguri Cap navigates her training and competitions, the series also introduces other racers, each with their own motivations and personal challenges. Their interactions, rivalries, and friendships create a rich ensemble story, giving depth to the world beyond a single protagonist. Through perseverance, personal growth, and the quiet drama of racing, Cinderella Gray shows how ambition and passion shape these characters both on and off the track.

name: Pinkalicious & Peterrific
summary: Pinkalicious & Peterrific follows the adventures of Pinkalicious and her brother Peter. Pinkalicious imagines creative possibilities everywhere she looks. She is an artist at heart—and, like most creative people, she sees the world differently from others. She knows what she likes, and she's not afraid to express herself—though she sometimes needs help from her brother, Peter, and her neighborhood friends.
